instruction: Resume the existing Design Reference Library Expansion parent. Normalize, qualify, license-check, score, cluster and experiment with these peer-researched candidates. Do not count a URL merely to hit 40. Extract reusable grammar: typography roles, density, composition, whitespace/release zones, image treatment, navigation, interaction, responsive behavior, anti-patterns. Merge with mono-color-skill and existing Westside references. Keep the parent active until >=40 qualified references across >=6 source families and >=3 materially distinct Storybook homepage directions are built and verified.

peer_findings.name: Remarque
peer_findings.lesson: Typography-first editorial system; book typography, strict font roles, constrained reading measure, perceptual color.

peer_findings.name: OpenDesign Warm Editorial
peer_findings.lesson: Warm paper substrate, serif-led magazine hierarchy, scarce accent, explicit color roles.

peer_findings.name: OpenDesign WIRED-inspired
peer_findings.lesson: Broadsheet density, rules instead of cards, typography stack, photography supplies most chroma, no rounded SaaS cards.

peer_findings.name: Postext
peer_findings.lesson: Programmable web typesetting; footnotes, margin notes, spacing rules, professional editorial layout primitives.

peer_findings.name: Quire
peer_findings.lesson: Content archetypes and density limits; one-accent scarcity; explicit rules preventing every surface from acting important.

peer_findings.name: Museum as Code
peer_findings.lesson: Cultural identity encoded as visual system with explicit typography scale and source-of-truth design spec; study method, not its Korean aesthetic.

peer_findings.name: Phosphor Design System
peer_findings.lesson: Complete themed editorial system with tokens, long-form application and explicit anti-patterns; useful as grammar packaging example, not aesthetic target.

peer_findings.name: Project Broadsheet
peer_findings.lesson: Publication-first information architecture: homepage, sections, archive, newsletter and editorial affordances rather than SaaS landing-page composition.

peer_findings.name: OpenDesign / opendesign
peer_findings.lesson: Large reusable design-system/skill library; deterministic visual directions instead of improvisational AI styling. Strong evidence for reuse-before-rebuild.

peer_findings.name: OpenDesign resource library
peer_findings.lesson: Machine-readable DESIGN.md plus deeper 11-layer design specs, computed styles, fonts and screenshot evidence; candidate model for Doré Knowledge Lab normalization.

peer_findings.name: Storybook Design System
peer_findings.lesson: Mature pattern for centralizing and visually verifying reusable UI instead of rewriting components; use for lab mechanics, not Westside visual identity.

peer_findings.name: mono-color-skill
peer_findings.lesson: Treat references as grammar, not templates; controlled ink roles, substrate, composition families, focal event and release zones. Translate method into New Westside-specific grammar.

westside_hypotheses: Direction A — Night Watch / Image Field: engraving or photographic field dominates 60–80%; typography collides with crop; night blue is state, gold is scarce dawn event; no card grid.

Direction B — Scripture / Typographic Declaration: Chinese scripture or editorial title is the primary visual object; warm paper and large release zones; marginal metadata and mono indexing; almost no decorative UI.

Direction C — Stone Archive / Cultural Publication: maps, archival plates, temple stone, dates, annotations and ruled information create navigation; entry points behave as indexed places/paths rather than feature cards.
negative_specimens: Penpot blue/gold fortress homepage: semantically on-theme but generic cultural-institution template; symbols decorate rather than generate layout.
Existing near-identical Storybook homepage micro-variants: reject as insufficiently distinct.
Generic SaaS cards, rounded component grids, evenly distributed emphasis, and safe left-copy/right-image hero layouts are anti-patterns for this research goal.
acceptance_next: Increase qualified catalog beyond current 21 only after normalization and rejection checks.
Populate at least 6 real source families rather than leaving family count at zero.
Build the three directions as Storybook specimens using real Westside content.
Verify visual and structural distinction before promotion to Doré Design; do not modify locked approved homepage during experiments.
